messages:
alex: Kicking off tenant_id type swap now. I pinned the service image to v2.9.1-mig for the release window.

deploy-bot: started pipeline release/2026-03-21/migration-tenantid

deploy-bot: acquiring exclusive DB lock on shard-3...

deploy-bot: lock acquired (holder: migration-worker-12). ETA on DDL ~2m

julia: thanks — i've pushed a small release notes blurb (link in the doc).

matt: quick ask: can we cap backfill concurrency to 6 to avoid replica lag?

sara: yes, set ratecap=6 in the deploy config and enable pg_stat_activity monitoring.

alex: updated deploy config: backfill_concurrency=6 rate_limit_per_worker=10

deploy-bot: applying DDL: `ALTER TABLE tenants ALTER COLUMN id TYPE uuid USING (uuid_generate_v4());`

deploy-bot: launching backfill job job-456 — initial progress 0%

oncall-bot: replica lag alert suppressed (expected) — monitoring at 5m cadence

matt: seeing ~18% TPS drop on shard-1, but replica lag stable under 30s so far

julia: quick decision rule: if lag > 60s -> abort and rollback. Plan A: pause backfill. Plan B: enable feature-flag fallback and revert service pin.

alex: ack. setting abort_threshold=60s in the runbook.

deploy-bot: backfill progress: 12% — rows/sec ~420

sara: sanity check: any services still reading tenant id as int? confirm migration-safe feature flag gating.

alex: confirmed — `tenantid_swap` flag is on for new reads only; legacy reads go through mapping service.

matt: recommend holding at 4% canary for extra 10m before ramping concurrency.

alex: can we hold at 4%?
deploy-bot: pausing backfill at 4% (manual hold by alex)

julia: looks good. please add rollback steps + emergency contacts to release notes.

alex: release notes updated with rollback commands and contact list. Roll-forward plan: resume with concurrency=8 if lag < 30s after 10m.

sara: +1

deploy-bot: hold released, resuming backfill. progress: 4% -> 5%...

oncall-bot: ephemeral alert: standby oncall @matt @sara

matt: watching. ping me if replica lag > 45s

alex: if we need to rollback, use the deploy command:
```
kubectl -n prod exec deploybot -- /bin/deploy rollback migration-tenantid --to-tag v2.9.0
```
julia: DB rollback notes: prefer feature-flag fallback. Raw reverse DDL would be: `ALTER TABLE tenants ALTER COLUMN id TYPE bigint USING (old_id)` but that's heavy — only for last-resort recovery.

deploy-bot: migration finished on shard-3. final backfill progress: 100%. DDL time: 38s. no locks held.

alex: nice. please mark this as closed in the release notes and update changelog.

julia: done, changelog and RN updated. closing thread. :tada:
